caption_en: decomineral style, flat mineral pigments, no chiaroscuro, pattern equal to form, closed color shapes, mountains patterned as dense forest, a great long-tailed bird perched in a stylized blossoming tree above a youth on horseback who reaches toward it, pink and grey rocky hills and patterned foliage filling the field, malachite green, cinnabar red, azurite blue, ochre, jade white
notes_zh: Shahnama《Zal 与神鸟 Simurgh》：神鸟栖于纹样花树，少年骑马仰望，粉绿山石。
